name: XSIJ burns the never-reset removePoolAmount from the pair on every sell
summary: XSIJ adds 25% of early liquidity removals to removePoolAmount and, on every sell, burns removePoolAmount from the XSIJ/USDT pair and syncs it without ever resetting the counter. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker bought XSIJ, sent 1 wei to the pair repeatedly so each transfer burned the same amount again until the pair's XSIJ reserve collapsed, and sold back for the pair's USDT.
notes: The owner's setLimit after deployment raised the buy and sell caps from zero, opening trading like an unpause; it is not a reset. removePoolAmount was fed by users' liquidity removals (live state).
Loss is the pair's USDT outflow, including the sell fees XSIJ paid to its fee wallets; the burned XSIJ is valued at nothing (rule 12).
